reviewed_semantics: Full-match bounded standalone RU/EN model question; compound commands keep the existing owner route.
Exact primary URL is checked before local proof reads; fallback 8085 never reuses primary model basename.
Root-owned strict bounded snapshot is derived byte-exactly from accepted audit f430bfb1; no credential, environment or model-weight exports.
Fresh pinned process lifetime, argv hash, executable/cwd hashes, owned socket FD, same network namespace and bounded LISTEN table proof are required twice.
Reader uses retained no-follow directory descriptors, bounded reads and descriptor cleanup; time limit is cooperative, not represented as hard wall time.
Prepared verified fact is rebuilt each request; failed proof removes prior verified basename and yields explicit unverified reference.
Identity-only payload keeps the bounded stable system prefix plus current fact and exact user question: two messages, no tools, generated token cap 256. Exact input token count is not claimed.
Branch uses existing actual model SSE path and rejects absent final message or tool calls; ordinary generic/tool loop statements are AST-identical.
Projection labels model reference only; no weight-content, architecture/training, prior-chat-backend, atomic-snapshot or global-listener uniqueness claim.
Proxy and owner route patch forward/inverse bytes and unaffected AST verified independently; postimages compile without execution.

author_validation.attribution: Author SOURCE_RECEIPT.json; not counted as new independent executions.

remaining_acceptance: Coordinator must compose installation with current O5 source prerequisites and existing startup transaction; independent restart is not authorized by this review.
Native post-install canary must confirm actual bounded system prefix fits, identity question streams a model response and ordinary tool questions still retain tools.
Process/socket proof is a bounded observation, not an atomic lifetime guarantee; changing backend invalidates the cached reference on a subsequent proof.
No native installation, restart, live model response or provider call was performed by this reviewer.
